title: Multi-target scale controls (100s of targets)
description: WIP limits, rate/fragility safety, delta rescans, bucketing.
detail: - **Bucket & prioritize:** (A) exposed mgmt/VPN/auth/remote, (B) web apps/APIs, (C) DB/cache/queue, (D) ICS/OT protocols, (E) file/infra. High-value/low-cost first. - **WIP limits:** cap concurrent workers/intents per bucket and globally; finish/park before spawning more (free capacity). - **Rate-limit & fragility:** throttle scans; **ICS/OT and fragile systems = read-identify only, low rate, no intrusive scripts, NO write/control/actuation**. - **Delta rescans:** track state in campaign graph; rescan only changed/new scope or stale targets — never blind full re-scans. - **Dedup:** `campaign_recall` + graph/asset lookup before new work; one source-of-truth per target. - **Timebox & stop-loss:** park stuck paths with WHY; revisit endgame.
